record.question: 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992 makes provisions for a 3-tier system of Panchayati Raj for all the States having population of above:
record.explanation: Answer B: 20 Lakh. Part IX permits the exception for states with populations not exceeding 20 lakh; the printed wording says “above,” so the threshold option is 20 lakh. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC SW/WCD Paper-I; year/source cover inspected..
